scientific_integrity: The \(\pi^2/6\) pathway itself is prior work and is not claimed as new. The claim is restricted to the exact finite-sample Bernoulli/BTL product law, its sine-product limit and correction, and the conditional no-self-correction identity.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for equal-size, fully observed two-item accumulation in the win-probability parameter; it does not establish an exact multi-item, sparse-graph, unequal-batch, or log-odds risk law.
title: Exact finite-sample risk inflation in two-item synthetic BTL augmentation
